open_points.subject: Project create request id
open_points.text: “the request id of its create, as the caller gave it … absent for a project the import brought in”
open_points.question: Who creates the request id for an ordinary owner-interface project creation, and must every such creation supply one?
options: The owner supplies a required request id
The owner interface mints and supplies a required request id
Registry mints it when absent
The request id is optional for ordinary creation
open_points.default_guess: The owner interface mints and supplies a required request id on the owner's behalf.

open_points.subject: Project request-id disclosure
open_points.text: “the request id of its create” is added as a Project fact, while “The project card ('read a project'): M01 with its object, rooms and revision” does not say whether this new fact is included
open_points.question: Which product actions, if any, return a Project's create request id: the create response, read-project card, context, list, or none?
options: Return it only in the create response
Return it in owner-facing Project reads as a Project fact
Return it in every projection containing the Project
Never return it after accepting the create
open_points.default_guess: Return it only in the create response, if needed, and omit it from later projections.

open_points.subject: Project replay after erasure
open_points.text: R0-36 says “A create repeated after a lost answer … never silently makes a second project”, but an anonymised Project loses “the request id of its create”, and deleting the Project whole removes the record
open_points.question: After a Project is anonymised or deleted, what durable fact still recognizes a retry of its original create so that it cannot create a second Project?
options: A separate durable replay record survives the Project
The request id survives erasure outside the Project
The replay guarantee expires when the Project is erased
A retry is refused by some other surviving identity
open_points.default_guess: Keep a separate durable replay record that survives Project anonymisation and deletion.

open_points.subject: Room create request id
open_points.text: “the request id of its create, as the caller gave it … absent for a room the import brought in”
open_points.question: For each ordinary room creation, must a request id be supplied, and who supplies it when the actor is the owner versus an agent through Kernel?
options: The owner interface and Kernel each mint and supply a required request id
The human owner or agent supplies it directly
Registry mints it when absent
It is optional for one or both creation paths
open_points.default_guess: The owner interface and Kernel each mint and supply a required request id for their respective calls.

open_points.subject: Room request-id disclosure
open_points.text: The Room gains “the request id of its create”, but State 0 defines the add-room output as “an identity Registry mints, the given name, its project” and does not say whether list-rooms or the agent projection returns the new fact
open_points.question: Which product actions, if any, return a Room's create request id?
options: Return it only in the add-room response
Return it in owner list-rooms but not to services or agents
Return it wherever the Room is projected, including to the agent
Never return it after accepting the create
open_points.default_guess: Return it only in the add-room response, if needed, and omit it from room lists and the agent projection.

open_points.subject: Customer create request id
open_points.text: “the request id of its create, as the caller gave it … absent for a Customer the import made”
open_points.question: Who creates the request id for an ordinary owner-interface Customer recording, and must every recording supply one?
options: The owner supplies a required request id
The owner interface mints and supplies a required request id
Registry mints it when absent
The request id is optional for ordinary recording
open_points.default_guess: The owner interface mints and supplies a required request id on the owner's behalf.

open_points.subject: Customer request-id disclosure
open_points.text: The Customer gains “the request id of its create”, while the defined customer read and list outputs enumerate other Customer facts without saying whether this new fact is returned
open_points.question: Which product actions, if any, return a Customer's create request id: the record response, customer read, customer list, billing read, or none?
options: Return it only in the record-customer response
Return it in owner-facing Customer reads
Return it in every projection containing the Customer
Never return it after accepting the create
open_points.default_guess: Return it only in the record-customer response, if needed, and omit it from later projections.

open_points.subject: Customer replay after erasure
open_points.text: R0-36 says a repeated create “never silently makes a second … customer”, but erasure removes “the request id of its create” while the erased Customer remains without that fact
open_points.question: After a Customer is erased, what durable fact recognizes a retry of its original record-customer request so that it cannot create a second Customer?
options: A separate durable replay record survives Customer erasure
The request id survives erasure outside the Customer
The replay guarantee expires on Customer erasure
The erased Customer retains a non-readable request-id fact despite “nothing else”
open_points.default_guess: Keep a separate durable replay record that survives Customer erasure.
